欧美.zh: 欧美娱乐圈被Taylor Swift的婚讯和Anthony Head去世消息刷屏。Swift与Travis Kelce被曝7月包场麦迪逊广场花园，若属实将是2026年最大娱乐事件；同时《巴菲》演员集体悼念72岁逝世的Anthony Head。Netflix电影负责人Dan Lin明确表示不会与坚持院线发行的电影人合作，但《纳尼亚传奇》是例外，引发行业震荡。此外，[Steven Spielberg表扬《Obsession》和《Backrooms》的票房成功](https://deadline.com/2026/06/steven-spielberg-praises-obsession-backrooms-success-1236942622/)，[House of the Dragon第三季战役片段在SXSW伦敦获赞](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/house-of-the-dragon-battle-secrets-season-3-sxsw-london-1236614904/)。Sean Penn在Tribeca谈第三座奥斯卡“如释重负”。整体来看，巨星动态与产业政策并行，流媒体与院线之战将持续升温。
欧美.en:
The US/Europe desk is packed with Taylor Swift's dual dominance—wedding rumors and a record-breaking song—plus the poignant loss of Anthony Head. Apple TV's Tonys potential and Spielberg's horror praise also set the tone for the week ahead.
- [Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce Are Planning July Wedding at Madison Square Garden](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/taylor-swift-travis-kelce-wedding-madison-square-garden-1236615147/) — Page Six reports a July wedding at MSG; neither Swift's nor Kelce's camp has confirmed.
- [‘Buffy the Vampire Slayer’ Cast Pay Tribute to Anthony Head](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/anthony-head-dead-buffy-the-vampire-slayer-cast-tributes-1236614926/) — Reactions from Sarah Michelle Gellar and others highlight Head's role as Giles and his off-screen warmth.
- [Taylor Swift’s ‘Toy Story 5’ Song Breaks Streaming Records](https://deadline.com/2026/06/i-knew-it-i-knew-you-music-video-taylor-swift-toy-story-5-1236942301/) — “I Knew It, I Knew You” becomes the most-streamed country song in a day by a female artist on Spotify.
- [Tonys: Apple TV Poised to Become Fastest Streamer to an EGOT](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/arts/tonys-2026-apple-tv-schmigadoon-egot-fastest-streamer-1236615095/) — A 'Schmigadoon!' win Sunday would complete the feat in 6.5 years, disrupting the industry's theatrical-first narrative.
- [Steven Spielberg Praises ‘Obsession’, ‘Backrooms’ Box Office Success](https://deadline.com/2026/06/steven-spielberg-praises-obsession-backrooms-success-1236942622/) — At a screening of 'Disclosure Day', Spielberg celebrated the horror genre's revival.

This desk signals a shift where streaming giants are aggressively chasing prestige awards while legacy talent is mourned and celebrated.

日韩.zh: K-pop夏日回归潮开启，[aespa等7组艺人发布新歌](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845585wpp/7-new-k-pop-releases-to-turn-up-the-heat-this-summer)，短兵相接。LE SSERAFIM金采源因颈痛治疗缺席Weverse Con，粉丝忧虑后续行程。韩剧方面，[《丈夫》公开李雪绑架戏份剧照](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845835wpp/lee-seol-is-a-hospital-chairwoman-and-namkoong-mins-wife-who-faces-a-shocking-kidnapping-in-the-husband)，[《Agent Kim Reactivated》发布主海报](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845828wpp/so-ji-sub-takes-center-stage-among-a-web-of-allies-and-enemies-in-agent-kim-reactivated)，So Ji Sub回归动作题材。日韩跨界合作方面，[Mia Takarabe与Steve Aoki新单《heartless》登陆印度市场](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQT09PVElUT19JTFRUUzNaQlhyZU96UzVUNXJmMmFJOEJqRjduWlBXcTZJbmlwU3ZoVFJMa0JnVTNUclF3d0h5VWlnRjRzNER6amp1VnRUcXVDeTZ5TkhiZ1VGWW1UZExLM3lncFdiMmNkdzdXWF94NUozaVMxc3lwb1o4OFFjM2tIc1lkZVBTM3pHZUpobzFtbDhwYm80WmdTU25DUnB2ZTByMTF3RG1Hd0J3)，拓展全球版图。金在中旗下男团VAYONN宣布出道计划，成员来自《BOYS II PLANET》。本周K-pop与韩剧均以健康、怀旧、跨界为主调，市场热力不减。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama news is led by LE SSERAFIM's health update and a fresh wave of summer releases. Several anticipated dramas dropped new stills, and a new boy group VAYONN set debut plans.
- [LE SSERAFIM Shares Update On Kim Chaewon’s Health And Upcoming Schedule](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845863wpp/le-sserafim-shares-update-on-kim-chaewons-health-and-upcoming-schedule) — Chaewon will miss the 2026 Weverse Con Festival due to doctor-advised rest; fans await her return.
- [7 New K-Pop Releases To Turn Up The Heat This Summer](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845585wpp/7-new-k-pop-releases-to-turn-up-the-heat-this-summer) — A roundup including aespa and others, driving streaming competition.
- [Former “BOYS II PLANET” Contestants And Kim Jae Joong’s Boy Group VAYONN Unveils Debut Plans](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845805wpp/former-boys-ii-planet-contestants-and-kim-jae-joongs-boy-group-vayonn-unveils-debut-plans) — Six-member group set to debut under iNKODE, capitalizing on survival show fame.
- [Lee Seol Is A Hospital Chairwoman And Namkoong Min’s Wife Who Faces A Shocking Kidnapping In “The Husband”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845835wpp/lee-seol-is-a-hospital-chairwoman-and-namkoong-mins-wife-who-faces-a-shocking-kidnapping-in-the-husband) — New stills hint at intense thriller dynamics.

K-pop's physical and competitive pressures remain central; watch for further schedule adjustments as summer festival season peaks.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博热搜被粉丝和争议事件占领。[腾讯S+项目《开到荼靡》因粉丝抵制导演更换登上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPaURDMUZsWEE4WWUwU0xVVVRFdHFoQ0cwQjYzQmZELTBBeUhtb1pNOUoxaEFld0JKNEFkZWZaa292c3Jldkp2aFpJOFJISGhwMlFlYVNBRDNESUZVNGNVQm1jekhXd1VRMlJ4c0hEemlrSFBQRVBSQklvdmgwSkNaZw)，制作方压力巨大。曾演《步步惊心》的中国男星直播痛哭“没戏拍”，[72字回应掀起行业寒冬讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOanlaT29ZTE9ZOEpQcUFLejdyMm9pNEl6ei03OVVycU5aWjQ4YmhvUGhJNlR3ZHZmVkg3MkJuck92cldvZmE3UFdmMl9SYUFTSkh0RmljMDlTcmdYTzIzX2RaRDJNYTJ1di1qOUVYRVo0NlpKNWJZR1hpMk5aNGkyQ19QQWZCZjdXSVFrZFFZOTQ2ZDlmTlVkcEZqTENXN2VTYWc)。此外，[王俊凯被限流](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE52S0U1NUJIdnBtS3p2emZmRlZZNEdVc2tXQWhXSEpNRUtFVy1lX2lIanN0Y1o0UzhCMFVlQThEc05jdjBpRjQxRk9nNVVQYjVScjVIZHZsS1VscnZ6Qi0xX1NiVQ)、[家业剧粉冲上热搜第一](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9tU1VnQlIycjNqNHpLLUZ5WmJMdFlhLVNoYzF1MnRkc1NWSWJqVkZvajFzVm5lc3VwdkdhM1NRSENqSWtINXpPT051WUZxOWRtcUtNTUEzQUp4V3FkdUNCNXhQbw)、[李晨送水晶兔子](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5zTU5PaVJSZkVJWEV3Z1hLdmJEX0hSVk5iY2pQSG8xZUl1T3JETGpnRnV5OC1OcFpBNlY1MGVwNVl5VkRjRFRJV2J2V3FJRzQ1ZlFwcXk2MUNZek1DMUtjUjVWZw)等话题也引发广泛讨论。高校教授“段子手式”简介出圈，反映大众对轻松内容的渴求。整体而言，微博社区今日弥漫着粉丝维权、行业悲鸣与娱乐化信息交织的复杂氛围。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media is buzzing with fan-driven controversies and celebrity gossip. A Tencent S+ drama faces director-change demands, drama fans pushed 'Jia Ye' to the top of trending topics, and stars like Wang Junkai and Li Chen are in the spotlight.
- [Tencent S+ project 'Kai Dao Tu Mi' director change controversy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPaURDMUZsWEE4WWUwU0xVVVRFdHFoQ0cwQjYzQmZELTBBeUhtb1pNOUoxaEFld0JKNEFkZWZaa292c3Jldkp2aFpJOFJISGhwMlFlYVNBRDNESUZVNGNVQm1jekhXd1VRMlJ4c0hEemlrSFBQRVBSQklvdmgwSkNaZw) — Fans are mobilizing against the director's involvement, a test of producer versus audience power.
- ['Jia Ye' drama fans hit trending number one](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9tU1VnQlIycjNqNHpLLUZ5WmJMdFlhLVNoYzF1MnRkc1NWSWJqVkZvajFzVm5lc3VwdkdhM1NRSENqSWtINXpPT051WUZxOWRtcUtNTUEzQUp4V3FkdUNCNXhQbw) — The fanbase successfully organically boosted the drama's visibility, showing grassroots influence.
- [Wang Junkai restricted on social media](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE52S0U1NUJIdnBtS3p2emZmRlZZNEdVc2tXQWhXSEpNRUtFVy1lX2lIanN0Y1o0UzhCMFVlQThEc05jdjBpRjQxRk9nNVVQYjVScjVIZHZsS1VscnZ6Qi0xX1NiVQ) — The actor faced platform limitations, sparking debate on content moderation.
- [Actor from 'Bu Bu Jing Xin' cried on livestream about lack of roles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOanlaT29ZTE9ZOEpQcUFLejdyMm9pNEl6ei03OVVycU5aWjQ4YmhvUGhJNlR3ZHZmVkg3MkJuck92cldvZmE3UFdmMl9SYUFTSkh0RmljMDlTcmdYTzIzX2RaRDJNYTJ1di1qOUVYRVo0NlpKNWJZR1hpMk5aNGkyQ19QQWZCZjdXSVFrZFFZOTQ2ZDlmTlVkcEZqTENXN2VTYWc) — The viral moment highlights industry unemployment anxiety among once-popular stars.

Fan activism is reshaping Chinese entertainment decisions; watch for official responses to the Kai Dao Tu Mi controversy.

中国.zh: 中国娱乐板块今日焦点在内容出海与资本市场。[《给阿嬷的情书》官宣全球上映计划](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5qdXJHUU1ia3hGaElzeHF4T3lQRmJhZHY4aHk4cmg2MFBMMmtscHNEdHR0QWN4WkppUVFqd29VYlVsZFFuUzRNVDln)，大麦娱乐推动中国故事走向世界。上海影视传媒导演杨磊强调[扎根中国文化才能引起全球兴趣](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBHV2FlWk1RYmN1TW5uQWRNdjRoMkkzRGwxaW5HOUdZeG82X1YwSTJBeWJRXzdEMmhLTkg3OE5xVG9ZOE9fWkd3TGF1SlJyeHdoa09NRlQxdDQ3Y3hCak9FTjBaNG1nc29UbHphVTFVZzNGSi1zM3lGLUJsQQ)。此外，[明星公司扎堆上市，专项基金被抢筹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5LOWdSTk9jSDdydE5DSEZQNFFVZ1lTMkJMTnNQa3NFdW1fVWpEdGJKTVpJYWludXpnVFhrTzFKTjJvaWozMy04VDVsbVVISkcxc1EyMXY1MFJFX09rWXNMYWtKaTF6QXhhd3UzRlRvaVc3OXNPc2tkWVBn)，资本市场对娱乐内容资产热情高涨。稻谷文化携杨子进军短剧出海，加速中国文化输出。不过，今日榜单中也混入部分非娱乐内容（如康师傅、有色金属），需注意编辑筛选。中国娱乐正经历“内容出海+资本变现”的双轮驱动，但行业内部恐仍在调整期。
中国.en:
China's entertainment industry is focused on global expansion and financing. Director Yang Lei emphasized cultural roots, the film 'Letter to Grandma' announced global release, and short-drama companies are going overseas. Celebrity-backed company IPOs are attracting investor interest.
- [Director Yang Lei: Rooting in Chinese culture makes global audiences interested](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBHV2FlWk1RYmN1TW5uQWRNdjRoMkkzRGwxaW5HOUdZeG82X1YwSTJBeWJRXzdEMmhLTkg3OE5xVG9ZOE9fWkd3TGF1SlJyeHdoa09NRlQxdDQ3Y3hCak9FTjBaNG1nc29UbHphVTFVZzNGSi1zM3lGLUJsQQ) — The Shanghai-based filmmaker advocates for authentic storytelling over imitation.
- ['Letter to Grandma' announces global release plan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5qdXJHUU1ia3hGaElzeHF4T3lQRmJhZHY4aHk4cmg2MFBMMmtscHNEdHR0QWN4WkppUVFqd29VYlVsZFFuUzRNVDln) — Da Mai Entertainment is leading the push for Chinese films overseas.
- [Dao Gu Culture partners with Yang Zi to take short dramas abroad](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE9IZncxeW5qYWVSNUFMUHBLTEx1dEdyOGNjTFlQbFlXb3V2R2RfeVUyQ3p0eW1yRkZSWjIxYlpBOGNwRUU0MmpOWEhpUTBaNzhvbEdmajA3WkQxN3NWMEk4VjNVd3E) — Short-form content continues to find international audiences.
- [Star-backed companies flock to IPO; special funds heavily oversubscribed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5LOWdSTk9jSDdydE5DSEZQNFFVZ1lTMkJMTnNQa3NFdW1fVWpEdGJKTVpJYWludXpnVFhrTzFKTjJvaWozMy04VDVsbVVISkcxc1EyMXY1MFJFX09rWXNMYWtKaTF6QXhhd3UzRlRvaVc3OXNPc2tkWVBn) — Investor appetite for entertainment IPOs remains strong despite market volatility.

The 'going global' strategy is consolidating, with both traditional films and short dramas targeting international markets. Expect further IPO announcements.
